PalateLog offers zero-cost cloud sync across family phones using your personal Google Drive with zero external servers. You can choose from two sync modes:
Mode A: Single Shared Family Account

• All family members sign in with the same designated Gmail (e.g. ourfamily.palatelog@gmail.com).\n• PalateLog automatically finds or creates the PalateLog_Family folder in Google Drive.\n• 1-tap sign in on each phone — no QR codes or invitations needed!

• Each family member signs in with their personal Gmail account.
• Step 1 (Host): One person creates the permanent family sync folder.
• Step 2 (Invite): Host enters member emails inside PalateLog. PalateLog automatically grants write permissions via Google Drive API.
• Step 3 (Connect): Host shares a static QR code or WhatsApp link (palatelog://sync?folderId=…). Family members scan or tap to connect!

Permission Pending Safety Net: If a family member scans the QR code before the host adds their email, PalateLog catches the error and offers a 1-tap \'Ask Host via WhatsApp\' button with a prefilled message.
Have you ever stopped at a highway tea stall, had terrible watery tea or dirty restrooms, and then stopped there again 6 months later because you forgot? The Quick Log is built to eliminate that.
1. Tap the floating 🔴 Quick Log button on the Explore screen.
2. GPS coordinates & reverse geocoded area name are populated automatically.
4. Tap quick reason chips: \'Watery tea\', \'Dirty restrooms\', \'Soggy food\', or \'Great chai\'.
50-Meter Reuse Banner: If you are standing near a spot you previously logged, PalateLog displays a one-tap banner to append notes rather than creating duplicate entries.
While the Quick Log is for rapid 3-second captures, the Full Visit Log is designed for sit-down dinners, family outings, and online food deliveries (Zomato/Swiggy).
What You Can Record in a Visit:
• Dining Channel: Tag whether you dined in, drove through, or ordered via delivery.
• Total Bill & Receipt Photo: Keep track of food expenses and snap receipt photos.
• Individual Dishes: Add multiple dishes consumed during that specific meal with verdicts.
• Family Attribution: Mark who attended and logged the visit.

The Delivery Dish Dichotomy: You order from a restaurant where the Biriyani is extraordinary, but the chicken fry arrives soggy and cold. PalateLog isolates dish-level performance so you never order the soggy dish again.
Fragrant ghee rice, tender meat. Re-order always!

• Avoid Dishes Shown First: The Dish Matrix always bubbles up 🔴 AVOID dishes to the very top so you catch them immediately before confirming a delivery cart.\n• Remembered Dish Chips: When editing subsequent visits, previously ordered dishes appear as 1-tap chips so you never have to retype names.
PalateLog features an offline-capable interactive map powered by OpenStreetMap to resurface previous learnings as you travel.
🟢 Green Pins: Exceptional spots, clean restrooms, & must-visit dhabas.
🔴 Red Pins: Roadside regrets & tourist traps to strictly avoid.
🟡 Amber Pins: Mixed experiences or caution spots.
• 1-Tap Navigation: Tap any pin on the map to view a bottom sheet preview, and launch turn-by-turn Google Maps navigation with 1 tap.
PalateLog is designed with local-first data sovereignty. You have complete control over what is shared with family members.

• Every restaurant, visit, and dish has a \'Share with Family\' checkbox.\n• Unchecked entries stay strictly in your phone\'s private SQLite database and are NEVER uploaded to Google Drive.\n• Only entries with \'Share with Family\' enabled are synced to the shared family folder.
• Distributed Conflict Resolution: Edits across phones are merged using Last-Write-Wins (LWW) timestamps so family updates never overwrite each other.
• Offline-First: The app operates 100% without internet. Edits queue locally and sync whenever Wi-Fi or mobile data becomes available.

Palate Radar accesses your device location while driving—including when the screen is locked or while using other navigation apps—to monitor up to 100 saved highway stops within 500 km and alert you 500 meters before you reach them.

• 100% On-Device: Your GPS coordinates are checked strictly against your local private database and Google Play Services Geofencing.
• Zero Tracking: Your location is never logged, stored, or sent to any server or third party.
• You Control It: Active only during your trip. You can stop Palate Radar at any time via the Quick Settings Tile or the persistent notification.
• Regrets Focus: By default, alerts you strictly for NO-GO roadside regrets. Want to see GO stops as well? You can enable them anytime in Settings.

Dynamic 500m geofencing, zero-battery trip monitoring, & Quick Settings tile

Driving on the highway at 80–100 km/h? Palate Radar acts as your roadside lookout, scanning ahead to alert you 500 meters before you reach previously logged roadside regrets or favorite highway stops.

• Dynamic Corridor Geofencing: Automatically checks up to 100 highway spots within 500 km of your starting GPS coordinates.
• 500m Proximity Warnings: High-priority heads-up notification with sound and vibration gives you ample time to safely pass or take the highway exit.
• Zero Perpetual Battery Drain: Runs strictly on-demand as a trip session while driving. It never tracks your location 24/7 in the background.
• Quick Settings Tile: Add the 'Palate Radar' tile to your Android notification shade for 1-tap start/stop without opening the app.
• Regrets First by Default: Strictly warns for NO-GO regrets to prevent notification noise on the road. You can enable GO recommendations in Settings.
• 100% On-Device Sovereignty: Your GPS coordinates are evaluated strictly on-device against your local Room database. Zero location telemetry is transmitted to any server.

Zoom in close to drop custom pins anywhere without magnetic snapping, or tap ✕ to unhook any latched venue.
🍽️ Food POIs: Sky blue pins indicating nearby restaurants discovered via map search.
⭐ My Saved: Restaurants you\'ve previously logged with color-coded verdicts (Green/Red/Amber).
📍 Custom Pin: Tap anywhere at street-level zoom (≥ 16.8) to place an exact custom location pin.
💡 Tips: Pan to auto-search new areas; tap ✕ on the bottom card to convert any venue back into a custom pin.

⭐ My Saved Places: Embossed gold star badge displaying your historical dining verdict (Green for Go, Red for No-Go, Amber for Caution). Selecting one in the picker automatically loads your remembered past dishes!
🍽️ Food POIs: Sky-blue bubble pins with cutlery icons representing nearby restaurants discovered from map data. Tap any POI to adopt its name and address.
📍 Custom Picked Spot: Gold pin marking your exact chosen coordinate when dropping a pin manually.
⭐ My Saved: Toggle your personal dining history pins on or off.
🍽️ Food POIs: Toggle third-party restaurant search pins on or off.
Dynamic Zoom Separation: Restaurant name labels spread apart and appear cleanly as you zoom in without visual clutter.
High-Zoom Precision: When zoomed in (zoom ≥ 16.8), tapping the ground drops a custom pin at your exact tap location without snapping to nearby restaurants.
1-Tap Unlink: If a pin latches onto a POI, tap the ✕ button on the details card to immediately convert it back to a free custom pin.
Pan & Auto-Search: Panning over 800m triggers a silent background search. If an area has no results or throttles, tap \'Search this area\' to retry.
